items.name: choicebox
items.title: Choicebox
items.description: A card-styled selection group for single and multi select, built on the Base UI Toggle Group. Horizontal rows or vertical cards, with radio or checkbox indicators. Fully theme-token driven and icon-library agnostic.

items.name: choicebox-radix
items.title: Choicebox (Radix)
items.description: The Radix variant of Choicebox — visually identical to the Base UI variant, built on the Radix Toggle Group (type="single" | "multiple"). Install this when your project's base is `radix`.

items.name: date-time
items.title: Date Time
items.description: A hydration-safe timestamp rendered in the viewer's locale and timezone. SSR and first client paint emit a deterministic value (no hydration mismatch), then it re-formats in the user's real timezone. Renders a semantic <time> element. Built on date-fns; no UI primitive, so it is identical across bases.

items.name: date-time-radix
items.title: Date Time (Radix)
items.description: The Radix-base variant of Date Time — identical to the Base UI variant (this component uses no UI primitive). Install this when your project's base is `radix`.
